items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Because of Leonard, then you get a Stanley Dance coming along a little later in his camp.

ctx.x: This is what I thought, that there was no -- if you want to criticize -- well, this is the trouble with this. Because of Leonard, then you get a Stanley Dance coming along a little later in his camp.
Oh, I don't think Stanley is in Leonard's camp.
No, but I got a review of a record with Barney Bigard , and he just was almost crying when Barney made that record with me.
